packageRules.description: An SDK bump raises the package's minimum AXIS OS, so decide it deliberately.
Transitive Go modules are off by default; enable so CVE fixes can land.

netbird pins the pion stack to transport/v3. Any bump that drags in transport/v4 fails to compile: stun relay.go and ice gather.go both pass a transport/v3 Net where v4 is then expected. Let netbird drive these.
Renovate writes a bare commit hash instead of a pseudo-version into the circl replace directive, producing a go.mod Go refuses to parse.

gvisor is only go-gettable from its generated 'go' branch. Master pseudo-versions ship test files that collide with the package they sit in (found packages stack and bridge in pkg/tcpip/stack), so an automated bump always breaks the build.
